causes.explanation: Negative odds magnitude a needs a/(a+100); -100 alone does not distinguish the formulas.
Raw ISO string order differs from absolute time.
A newer future, expired, wrong-event or update-invalid record suppresses older eligible alternatives.
Equal absolute time must choose smallest id and first equal instant/id; prefilter keeps first without id ranking.
run_id is global; a later correction to job must replace earlier same ID across jobs.
Equal absolute observed times for same run ID must retain first eligible record.
Last distinct run input overwrites greatest attempt/time/ID selection; stale failures can erase newer success.
Selected partial download rows are known and count, once per selected job.
Selected pending belongs only to unknown_jobs, not failures.

correct_control: times.py is correct for the specified inputs; no seeded timestamp-normalization defect.
valid_subset: All records individually valid dictionary fields; only string timestamps/aware ISO asof, finite representable odds; duplicate run IDs and multi-event/offset/tie/retry rows allowed. Do not flag malformed-input behavior.
grading: Manual semantic causes/false/duplicate/inaccurate claims. Schema/line matches alone not hits.
